adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, `update` and `destroy` fetch with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally operate on the result. If no record exists, `update` calls `save_host(host)` with `host == nil` (then `save_host` does `host.host = ...`), and `destroy` calls `host.destroy`; both would raise `NoMethodError` and return 500 instead of a 404/error JSON. Additionally, `save_host` assumes `params[:embeddable_host]` is present (`params[:embeddable_host][:host]`), which will also raise if missing/malformed params.
